name: PdxNavbar
description:
A responsive app header holding the brand, the navigation links and the user's avatar with its
dropdown.

members.name: label
members.description:
The navigation landmark's name. Empty: the navbar.mainNav component string, «Main
navigation». Give each navbar on a page its own: a sub-nav, a footer nav.

members.name: toggleMobile
members.description: Open or close the mobile menu, moving focus into it when it opens.

events.name: pdx-select
events.description: A link was chosen: its `key` and its item.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description:
The navigation landmark's name. Empty: the navbar.mainNav component string, «Main
navigation». Give each navbar on a page its own: a sub-nav, a footer nav.

slots.description: The content placed inside the element.

cssParts.name: bar
cssParts.description: The row that holds the brand, the toggle, the nav and the actions.

cssParts.name: toggle
cssParts.description: The button that opens the drawer while the navbar is collapsed.

cssParts.name: nav
cssParts.description: The `<nav>` of the links in the bar.

cssParts.name: item
cssParts.description: A link, in the bar or the drawer; the current one is `aria-current="page"`.

cssParts.name: actions
cssParts.description: The navbar's children, moved to the end of the bar.

cssParts.name: drawer
cssParts.description: The `<nav>` of the links shown under the bar while collapsed.

cssStates.name: sticky
cssStates.description: `sticky` is set: it stays at the top as the page scrolls.

cssStates.name: collapsed
cssStates.description: Its bar does not fit its width: the links go behind the toggle.
